text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, understood! 
Please connect the feed to each stage as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Every venue is proceeding smoothly to 
packed crowds. 
Part two is about to begin... and with it,

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
comes the premiere 
of "GIRLS' LEGEND U."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This song won't just be performed 
here on Stage A; 
it will be performed simultaneously across 
Stage B, Stage C, and every other stage as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Every horsegirl will sing in unison, 
igniting the passion of all the fans at 
once.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, our technical crew pooled all their 
efforts together 
for this. It's guaranteed to be an 
unforgettable show!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To all the horsegirls, and to every fan 
out there. 
—And to you, too!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Countless lights swaying in a sea of 
vibrant colors—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Within each and every one of those lights, 
people's hopes and feelings surely dwell. 
...What a deeply stirring, beautiful 
sight.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I cannot let everyone's expectations go in 
vain. 
Upon this stage as well, I shall make a 
splendid flower bloom.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing spring, summer, autumn, and 
winter, 
yearning and longing...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's quite an interesting song, 
isn't it? 
After all, in the end, it always circles 
back to running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But that's what makes it so like us 
horsegirls. 
I think the lyrics turned out truly 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! 
*Inhaaaale*... *exhaaaale*...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone! 
We're gonna give it everything we've got, 
song and heart alike!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Through this concert, you shall gain 
power! 
Broaden your possibilities, maximize the 
utility of your bonds, 
and surpass your very limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that includes you too, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can't stop now, and we're not going to! 
Let's sing it together, everyone! 
"GIRLS' LEGEND U"!

All that remains now is for "GIRLS' LEGEND 
U" 
to echo across the stage—
